<div class="card-body">
'''Gold 2''' is a [[Light]] [[Starship]] ([[Starfighter]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊ゴールド2</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">パイロットと乗客を合計2名まで追加できる。「デス・スター：トレンチ」で命中を受けた他の宇宙戦闘機のかわりに没収することができる。パイロットなしでは戦闘力、回避値、航行速度を使用できない。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Gold-2-SWCA-67667.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">タイリーがヤヴィンの戦いで搭乗したYウイング。カスタム装備の側面スラスターが運動性能を向上させている。このためゴールド2は相手の砲火をかいくぐるのが得意だ。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Gold 2.

'''Card text:'''
May add up to 2 pilots and passengers in total. May be forfeited in place of another starfighter hit at Death Star: Trench. May not use power, maneuver, or hyperspeed without a pilot.

'''Lore:'''
The Y-wing Tiree flew at the Battle of Yavin. Custom side thrusters improve its handling, so Gold 2 is good at slipping through enemy fire.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Gold 2]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
